acceptanceCriteria: check-host-package-versions.sh enumerates protocol/integrations packages or documents why each is excluded
a test changes shipped protocol/integrations content without a bump and the check fails
body:
Observed by the docs batch lane (2026-10-21): shipped content under protocol/integrations can change without the host-package-versions check requiring a version bump, while integrations/* packages are checked (see V1-2145 for the bump ergonomics).
Expected: every shipped integration package, including protocol/integrations, is covered, or the exclusion is documented with a reason.
title: check-host-package-versions.sh does not cover protocol/integrations packages
